body:
📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
Occurrence #211 (first post since 2026-11-26T09:26:21Z; overnight occurrences #211-#218 are covered by this one post, #212-#218 suppressed to docs/actionable/2026-11-27.md).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`); heartbeat sibling `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Overnight fires (DD events API):
  • 302057011 runtime-core-subscriber throughput: Triggered 23:54:31Z, 00:39:31Z (+Re-Trig 01:09:31Z), 02:24:31Z, 03:28:31Z; each self-recovered in 10-26 min
  • 302055141 method-mobile-notifications-subscriber heartbeat: No Data 00:41:21Z, 04:08:21Z (+renotify 05:08, 06:08Z), 07:40:21Z, 09:33:21Z

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()` 23:00-04:30Z → 165 points; overnight trough 0.2-2 msg/s (floor 2), short bursts 15-63/s, morning ramp back to *119-147/s from 04:00Z*
  • DD metric `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()` 23:00-10:00Z → only *22 points in 11h*, every one above the 0.005/s floor (min 0.0083, max 0.208); No Data = gaps between sparse messages
  • DD logs `service:runtime-core-subscriber status:error env:prod` 23:30-04:00Z → *0*; `service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber status:error` 00:00-10:00Z → *0*
  • Reasoning: Both monitors trip only in the US overnight low-traffic window. The consumers are not stalled: throughput recovers on its own and there are 0 errors. This is the KB quiet-period shape. Gate: about 26h since the last post (cycle-eval convention). The fire-ts anchor would have given 14.5h and suppressed; disclosed.

Suggested next action: none for ops (within KB bounds). The standing recommendation to make these floors time-of-day aware remains open.
_Source alerts: n/a (degraded cycle: Slack MCP absent; reconstructed from the DD events API; no permalinks)._
